subject.title: feat: add chain-of-thought pre-flight planning for long-running goals

question: Should OpenClaw expand durable session goals into model-mutable step-plan state, or should long-running planning stay behind the existing gated `update_plan`/task-flow contract?
rationale: The PR is not only an implementation detail; it adds persistent goal state, new default model-facing mutating tools, and a new config/default surface, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Pause for goal-plan API design
options.body: Decide the durable state and tool boundary first, then have the contributor or a repair lane rework the branch around the approved contract.

options.title: Repair behind existing planning gates
options.body: Keep the feature idea but route it through the current planning-tool exposure policy and strict config/schema/docs flow before merge.

options.title: Approve a new goal-plan contract
options.body: Accept goal-owned plan snapshots intentionally, with migration expectations, retry semantics, docs, schema coverage, and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Pause for goal-plan API design
recommendation.body: Decide the durable state and tool boundary first, then have the contributor or a repair lane rework the branch around the approved contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail connects this handle to the current planning tool gate and session-goal behavior that the PR would change.
